body:
Also, in /api/v1/markdown preview (while editing file through web), not only for commit references wrong link href is generated, but for issue links too. Example markdown: ``` # test Commit 056dd42 Issue #1 ``` Result is: ```

test

Commit 056dd42

Issue #1

``` Should be: ```

test

Commit 056dd42

Issue #1

```
